description: Remote routing of a model that has a local profile and a remote profile: which local states send a request for the model's bare name to the remote profile, what X-SIE-Remote changes, and how the local refusal answers a failed remote attempt. A single server ('single_node') and a gateway ('gateway') each check every vector, mapping the abstract local states and models below to their own topology. A vector that lists 'topologies' applies only to those.

local_states.ready: The local profile can serve the request now.
local_states.loading: The local profile is not loaded. A single server is loading it; a gateway has a local worker that has not loaded it.
local_states.no_worker: No local worker exists. Only a gateway has this state.
local_states.saturated: The local queue cannot take the request.
local_states.unhealthy: The local profile cannot serve. On a single server its load failed; on a gateway its worker is unhealthy.

models.bare: The bare name of a model whose routing policy is fallback, with fallback_profile remote.
models.local_profile: The same model with its local profile named explicitly.
models.remote_profile: The same model with its remote profile named explicitly.
models.remote_only: A model served only by an upstream.

notes.bridge: remote true: the request is served by the remote profile and the response names fallback_reason in X-SIE-Fallback-Reason. remote false: the request is served or refused locally and carries no X-SIE-Fallback-* header. triggers null means the policy declares none, which enables provisioning and model_loading.
notes.remote_header: Each entry lists the X-SIE-Remote field values of one request. Only exactly one 'forbid' is accepted.
notes.forbid: With X-SIE-Remote: forbid. remote false: served or refused locally, never by an upstream, with no X-SIE-Fallback-* header.
notes.named_profile: A request that names a profile is served as written: the local profile never goes remote, and the remote profile is served remotely without a fallback reason.
notes.fallback_error: X-SIE-Fallback-Error for a failed remote attempt that answered with status and SIE error code (null: no code). An SIE error code passes through in any letter case, server_overloaded and invalid_request (exactly) become QUEUE_FULL and INVALID_INPUT, PROVISIONING (exactly, a remote route whose capacity is still starting) becomes QUEUE_FULL, and otherwise a status from 500 is INFERENCE_ERROR and a lower one INVALID_INPUT.
notes.restored_refusal: A failed remote attempt is answered with the local refusal it replaced: the same status, code and Retry-After (null: none), X-SIE-Served-By: local, no X-SIE-Upstream, and X-SIE-Fallback-Reason and X-SIE-Fallback-Error set. unanswered_before_deadline: a gateway deadline passed before the remote attempt answered anything.
